Continue only the six existing bounded workstreams with their current measurement gates. Aggregate commission is $4.92 and unattributed; site-level revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, and forecasts remain unsupported. Keep SearchWoot private pending owner direction and unresolved rights, legal, security, accuracy, privacy, attribution, and measurement gates.

Choose whether to authorize preparation of an unsent provider-permission request, keep SearchWoot private with no outreach, or end the public-beta pursuit. No outreach, launch, monetization expansion, telemetry change, or production change is approved.

Retain only existing bounded workstreams for 0xroulette.com revenue-readiness evidence, marineactivity.com AIS baseline, aliencouncil.com UAP baseline, fishhooklabs.com guide improvement, stinkyleftfoot.com guide improvement, and americastrikes.com affiliate repair. Require isolated scope, existing smoke or reachability checks, rollback notes, and measurement at 14 days or 100 new impressions. Do not create duplicates or treat failed requests as completed.

Reject the proposed high-priority security queue work. Maintain the private gate using the existing launch-readiness record; do not request duplicate telemetry already covered by the shared snapshot. Reconsider only after the owner decision and completion of the existing rights, legal, accuracy, privacy, attribution, security, and measurement gates.

Recommendation: approve only the three bounded engineer changes below. Revenue, ROI, margin, CAC, payback, profitability, and forecasts remain unsupported because the $4.92 commission is aggregate and unattributed, direct costs are unavailable, and no outcomes are proven. Keep the private launch gate unchanged. Decision question: authorize preparation of an unsent provider-permission request?
